title: salvia dorrii var. pilosa
intro: Salvia dorrii var. pilosa, commonly known as Utah sage, is a perennial plant species in the sagebrush family (Lamiaceae) native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Salvia dorrii var. pilosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including salvianolic acid, ursolic acid, and rosmarinic acid, which have been shown to possess neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, the plant's leaves and flowers can be used in teas, infusions, and tinctures to support mental clarity, improve mood, and soothe digestive issues.
